description: The Kit demo exam as a machine-checkable evaluation. Seventeen questions across three live, public, read-only kits: the Mayfur fiction pair (retrieval provable against an invented world) and the ballast case file (real history, provenance-first). Every probe is a keyless GET; expectations match stable entry titles. v1.1 (2026-07-26) renames 'synthesis' to 'chain' (the harness scores that the cross-store chain surfaces; it does not grade a conclusion) and adds four hard absence questions (H1-H4) that the reference system currently fails, added after two independent cold reviews broke the easy-absence claim. Design + answer key: Kit memory m#160260 and m#160431.
